subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should reply-session initialization conflicts recover in shared session lifecycle code, in Discord transport dispatch, or through an intentionally layered combination?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 address the same named conflict at different ownership boundaries, and source inspection cannot determine the intended permanent layering without maintainer direction.

options.title: Shared recovery first
options.body: Land the fenced shared-session self-heal, then prove whether any Discord-specific transient retry is still necessary.

options.title: Layer both recoveries
options.body: Keep a minimal bounded Discord retry outside shared self-healing and add explicit interaction, retry-count, cancellation, and exact-once proof.

options.title: Discord-only recovery
options.body: Use the transport retry and decline the broader shared-session self-heal direction.

recommendation.title: Shared recovery first
recommendation.body: Land the fenced shared-session self-heal, then prove whether any Discord-specific transient retry is still necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared initializer and much of the current Discord processing path trace to his recent merged work.
